description: Adds a trigger output of its own for every step of the 8 Step Sequencer, and is placed immediately to the right of it

outputs.text: Carries 10V for as long as the clock pulse is high as the sequencer moves to the step of that number, whatever the gate and trigger buttons on the sequencer are set to

notes: the 4 Bit Sequence Encoder also drives this expander; no other Count Modula sequencer does
a further expander placed immediately to the right of this one is fed the same sequence detail
